text:
alex: Heads-up — PR #21400 is blocked on CI. macOS shard (macos-11 / shard-2) keeps failing with `session-reconnect-test` timeout. I kicked a full rerun but it's flaky across runs. https://buildkite.com/redwood/prs/21400/builds/7890

sam: Can you paste the failing snippet? is it timing out waiting for WS reconnect or asserting state?

alex: It's a timeout waiting for reconnect + an assertion on `session.isActive`. Here's the failing bits from the job log: ```
Error: Timeout waiting for session reconnect after 30000ms
 at tests/session-reconnect.test.ts:42:18
AssertionError: expected false to equal true
```

ci-bot: Buildkite #7890 finished — Status: failed. Failed job: macos-11-shard-2. Retry allowed: yes. https://buildkite.com/redwood/prs/21400/builds/7890/jobs/12

riley: Looks similar to the intermittent we saw last month. Owner of `session-reconnect-test` is @maria right? Could be infra slowness on macos VMs.

maria: Yep, I own it. I can run a targeted rerun on shard-2 and tail logs. If it still flakes we should do a bisect to find the regression commit. For now I'll queue a targeted rerun (only macos shard) — should be up in ~5m.

qa-automation: Queued targeted rerun: `bk rerun --job macos-11-shard-2 --build 7890`. Watch link: https://buildkite.com/redwood/prs/21400/builds/7891

alex: Thanks — if the rerun passes, can someone approve/merge? This PR is a small routing fix and we have approvals, but CI gate is blocking.

lee: I can give a merge approval if rerun is green and no other failing shards. :thumbsup:

sam: If the rerun still flakes, can we temporarily quarantine this test or add `[flaky]` annotation in test metadata until root cause found? Quarantining would allow this harmless change to land. CC @platform for CI policy.

maria: Prefer to avoid quarantining unless we see persistent failures. First rerun queued. If it fails again I'll run two more targeted reruns + reproduce locally on macos-11 image. If reproduces locally I'll start bisect.

qa-automation: Rerun finished: https://buildkite.com/redwood/prs/21400/builds/7891 — macos-11-shard-2: FAILED (same timeout).

alex: Ugh. Ok, next steps? I don't want this to block release window.

riley: Can you try `TEST_SEED=42 npm run test:macos -- grep session-reconnect` locally or with a dev VM? If we can't repro locally it's likely infra noise. Also check recent infra image updates around 3/8 that touched network agent.

maria: I'm spinning up a reproducible macos-11 runner to run the test in a loop. If it's infra, we'll file a support ticket with cloud provider and request a retry window. If it's our change, bisect.

lee: For short-term unblock: I'm ok with an org-level policy exception to merge with a second approver + post-merge monitoring if we can run a quick canary on prod traffic or smoke tests. @sam can you ok that?

sam: Fine with that contingency. Condition: must pass two back-to-back targeted reruns OR we quarantine the test and open bug with owner + 24h follow-up.

alex: I'll wait for maria's repro attempt. Thanks everyone.

maria: Update: local loop repro failed so far (ran 30x). Looks like CI VM is adding ~200-400ms delay on socket handshakes sometimes. I'm escalating to infra and will attach traces. Meanwhile I'll attempt one more rerun with extended timeouts for just this test to see if it stabilizes.

ci-bot: Buildkite #7892 started by qa-automation (targeted rerun with extended timeout).

qa-automation: Rerun #7892 completed — macos-11-shard-2: PASSED.

alex: Great — per sam's rule can we get one more green and then lee + sam will approve?

lee: will approve after one more green.

sam: ack, will approve post-second-green.

maria: Queued one more targeted rerun (7893).

qa-automation: Rerun #7893 finished — macos-11-shard-2: PASSED.

lee: Approved.

sam: Approved.

alex: Merged. Thanks all — filing follow-up ticket for infra trace + consider adding a transient increase to reconnect timeout in test harness. PR #21400 merged to main. :rocket:
